caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a ceremonial or ornate staff, rod, or scepter, displayed upright on a plain, light beige background. The head of the object is a rounded, shell-like or leaf-shaped form rendered in light gray pencil, adorned with detailed linear patterns and symmetrical decorations, including leaf motifs and a beaded garland design. At the center of the head is a circular, gold-toned medallion or emblem. The shaft of the object is long and narrow, transitioning from a plain light section beneath the head to a dark, twisted or spiraled section that extends down toward the base. The base appears to end with a short, narrow metallic tip. At the lower right corner of the drawing, handwriting in pencil reads: "HAROLD SMITH CITY MUSEUM 2ND FLOOR CENTER CASE NO 2."
title: Silver Punch Ladle
